candidates.snippet: Madyar, commander of @usf_army, tells SVT that Russia will never again say "Kyiv in three days" like before the full-scale war, but whether the Baltics can withstand "three days," he's uncertain. NATO isn't ready for modern drone warfare, he says. https://t.co/9ctysJCUCg
Putin has ordered a three-day halt to strikes on Kyiv starting September 5 at midnight due to the upcoming American delegation visit, Kremlin spokesman Peskov claims. https://t.co/Zib6nCwXLx
